Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Class Character

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Symbol
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Character
All Implemented Interfaces:
Commented, Comparable<Character>
public class Character extends Symbol implements Comparable<Character>
A character is a story graph symbol that represents one of the agents in a story. A character can consent to take actions, has (possibly wrong) beliefs about the current state, and has a utility that represents how desirable they find the current state. A character can optionally be marked as a player character, meaning their actions are typically chosen by a person interacting with the story.

New characters should be created in a story graph using the CharacterList.add(String) method.

Characters are the labels of epistemic edges.

Author:
Stephen G. Ware
